results.notes: NOT REPRODUCED. The printed arm means are adjusted ANCOVA means, not raw means. Exact paper-model reproduction is unavailable: PDF pp. 7-8 specifies five MICE datasets, baseline draft score, age, gender, AI literacy and creative personality, followed by model-specific Cook's D > 4/n exclusions. The only posted data file contains the original participant rows, with no imputation indicator, imputed copies, retained-case flags, imputation equations, seed, pooling details or analysis syntax. Eight people have both questionnaire covariates missing, rather than the five people reported on PDF p. 7. No missing value was imputed or inferred. Original one-based missing-data rows: [24, 35, 52, 53, 85, 92, 100, 108]. One entirely empty trailing SAV row (113) was removed. The remaining 112 rows contain unique participant identifiers and complete draft outcomes; the group value labels explicitly map 1=AI-first, 2=AI-follow, 3=AI-parallel, 4=Human-only. All four valid-case arm counts and male counts match PDF p. 4. The outcome used for the diagnostic is the stored 'Final Draft Average' field. These are participant draft scores, not independent rater observations. Unadjusted full-pool treatment/control means are 4.808 and 5.53620689655, versus printed adjusted means 4.81 and 5.65. The raw treatment mean's rounding match is insufficient: the control mean and analysis procedure do not match. As a transparent failure diagnostic only, an OLS ANCOVA using the paper's listed regressors was fitted on complete cases, with Human-only as reference and one pass excluding Cook's D > 4/n. Adjusted diagnostic means hold all five covariates at the fitted sample means. This is not a substitute for MICE. Before exclusion: n=104, arm counts={1: 25, 2: 21, 3: 29, 4: 29}, treatment/control adjusted means=4.77301078456/5.38097858927. This diagnostic excludes 6 people at D > 0.0384615384615; original one-based rows=[3, 11, 45, 55, 79, 102]. The paper reports 7 exclusions after imputation. Equal exclusion totals, if any, do not identify the same sample. After exclusion: n=98, arm counts={1: 24, 2: 21, 3: 26, 4: 27}, treatment/control adjusted means=4.78147838435/5.46269637204; these do not match at two decimals. No final paper-model arm counts are printed, and none were inferred from degrees of freedom or subtracted exclusions. The printed d standardizer and robust covariance implementation are unspecified. Stored overall averages differ from the four subscale arithmetic averages at preliminary rows [3, 46, 103] and final rows [9, 70, 73, 76, 85, 97, 103]; scores were used as deposited without repairs. Participant-level SDs, unadjusted effects, and HC2 SEs were not computed because the required reproduction gate failed. Every field in 'computed', including se_type, is consequently null. 'round=all' refers to this between-person final-draft contrast. Fixed AI-access schedules do not establish a randomized-order within-person crossover, so no paired or additional first_round result is appropriate.
